heading: SoftBank's OpenAI investment: Inside Masayoshi Son’s massive $11 billion gamble on ChatGPT's future
author: LiveMint Editorial
paragraphs: SoftBank Group plans to sell over $11 billion in bonds, aiming to raise $10 billion in dollar bonds and 1 billion euros for investments, including OpenAI. The deal may set new yield records. Recent activities include securing loans, highlighting its significant role in AI financing.
